plugins.name: dynamia
plugins.description: Multi-repo workspace tools for Claude Code: batches, guard hooks, token-cheap agents and a dev-env panel.

plugins.name: dynamia-craft
plugins.description: Working discipline for Claude Code: ask before building, find the root cause before fixing, plan in small steps, answer clearly.

plugins.name: dynamia-platform
plugins.description: Work with Dynamia Platform: backend patterns, ZK, Vue frontend, live docs from GitHub and the dynamia CLI.

plugins.name: dynamia-ui
plugins.description: UI and UX tools for Claude Code: extract, improve or create a design system; review UX, mobile, SEO, offline and performance; evaluate the frontend stack.

plugins.name: dynamia-colombia
plugins.description: Colombian tax and compliance for Claude Code: DIAN glossary, electronic invoicing, información exógena (medios magnéticos), taxes, and how to find and cite current rules from official sources.

plugins.name: dynamia-java
plugins.description: Modern Java 25 and Spring Boot 4 for Claude Code: idioms, concurrency, Spring Boot and Hibernate 7 practices, upgrades and a Java review checklist.

plugins.name: dynamia-kotlin
plugins.description: Kotlin for backend work: idioms and Java interop, coroutines, Kotlin with Spring Boot 4, Ktor and Exposed services, Gradle and Maven builds, and a Kotlin review checklist.

plugins.name: dynamia-test
plugins.description: Testing for JVM and web projects: test strategy and review, JUnit 6 and Spring Boot 4 tests, Vitest and Playwright, failing-test triage, and coverage and mutation quality gates.

plugins.name: dynamia-docs
plugins.description: Documentation for software projects: READMEs, architecture decision records, API and code docs, changelogs, runbooks, diagrams, and audits that keep docs true to the code.

plugins.name: mcp-tool-chain
plugins.description: Chain many MCP tool calls in one short Python script, so intermediate results never pass through the model's context. Imports the stdio MCP servers it finds.

plugins.name: dynamia-remix
plugins.description: Remix an app you admire into your own product, clean-room: map it, plan and rebuild it, score parity, read what its users hate, and rebrand so nothing of the original is left.

plugins.name: dynamia-mysql
plugins.description: Safe MySQL, Percona Server and MariaDB work: connect without leaking passwords, inspect a database, check replication and build a new replica, with a guard against destructive statements.
